reason: The logo placement and size are incorrect relative to the red bounding box intended for the logo. Additionally, the product does not meet the branding and content constraints as specified in the validation criteria.

lastAdjustment.reason: The logo needs to be enlarged to better fill the red bounding box area (around 60–95% of the box width). It should also be centered within the red box by shifting 20 pixels to the left and 30 pixels downward. The drink needs to remove the lid and straw to meet content constraints, and the strawberry pieces, whole fruit, and ice cubes around the cup must be eliminated.
